# BAD-065 — collab: upload-url reports a missing or zero byte count as *_too_large

## Brief
upload-url's size check is one expression — Number.isFinite(bytes) && bytes > 0 && bytes <= MAX — and every way of failing it answers the same code: bytes:0, bytes:-1, bytes:'lots' and a body with no bytes at all all come back 413 {code:'thumb_too_large'|'scene_too_large'|'take_too_large', max}. A client told 'too large' for a value that is nothing of the kind will show the wrong copy and may retry by shrinking something that was never the problem. A distinct 400 bad_bytes for the not-a-positive-number half would cost one branch per kind and say what actually happened.

Evidence: collab/index.ts:985-988 (thumb), :999-1002 (scene), :1010-1013 (take), :1019-1022 (cam). Pinned in test/server/functions.test.mjs, 'collab: upload-url refuses before it ever signs': bytes of 0, -1, 'lots' and null all answer 413 thumb_too_large against a local stack.
